patch_description:
This redesign replaces the heavyweight `PathData` copying/scoring flow with a flat route-state architecture:

- Routes are stored as compact direction bytes rather than characters.
- Board cells are represented by flat integer IDs.
- Legal transitions and APSP first-step directions are precomputed in flat arrays.
- Scoring no longer allocates or clears per-cell visit vectors. It computes cyclic visit gaps in one route scan using first/last visit timestamps and per-cell accumulated terms.
- Candidate states only copy the move sequence; coordinates and score metadata are rebuilt only after a successful proposal.
- Backtrack deletion samples valid removable pairs directly instead of constructing a full candidate-index list.
- Closed-loop reversal is retained as a legal structural edit, avoiding invalid arbitrary segment reversals.

This substantially reduces allocation, copying, pointer chasing, and scorer overhead, allowing many more local-search iterations within the same time budget.
